'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 1 Aaron Nelson DS Kessel''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Kessel (Dark)|Kessel]]
* '''Username:''' Airdog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
